sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_20a0dc543b3c83107cf65c0f23e45a2f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_884051_01chang_0.ChangeRiskCalc</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChangeRiskCalc</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ChangeRiskCalc = Class.create();
ChangeRiskCalc.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	calculaterisk: function(chg){
		var score = 0;

		//impact
		if(chg.impact==1) score += 40;
		else if(chg.impact ==2) score +=25;
		else score +=10;

		//urgency 
		if(chg.urgency ==1) score += 40;
		else if(chg.urgency == 2) score +=25;
		else score += 10;

		//category 
		if(chg.category == 'network') score += 20;
		if(chg.category == 'Security') score += 30;

		return score;
	},

	risklevel: function(score){
		if(score >= 80) return 'High';
		else if(score >= 50) return 'Moderate';
		else return 'low';
	},

    type: 'ChangeRiskCalc'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-07 15:50:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>20a0dc543b3c83107cf65c0f23e45a2f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChangeRiskCalc</sys_name><sys_package display_value="01Change_lite" source="x_884051_01chang_0">8f2c40583bf883107cf65c0f23e45a91</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="01Change_lite">8f2c40583bf883107cf65c0f23e45a91</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_20a0dc543b3c83107cf65c0f23e45a2f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-07 16:51:27</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
